name: x'' = x^2, written as a first-order system
question: With what exponent does x'' = x^2 blow up in finite time, and does the degree of the equation predict it?
assumptions: x' = y, y' = x^2 (the autonomous part of the first Painleve equation)

provenance.source: dominant balance: S. Kovalevskaya, Acta Math. 12, 177 (1889); A. Goriely and C. Hyde, J. Differential Equations 161, 422 (2000)
